text:
sarah: FYI AP ingested an Aether Labs invoice with no PO on the PDF. Invoice 49201, vendor Aether Labs (vendor id 3342). Routing went to AP instead of ENG approver.
tom: Ugh. Which project/cost center should it hit?
sarah: PR 2219 was under ENG-ML (cost center ML-RESEARCH). The supplier should have included PO 2219 on the invoice.
rachel: Do we have a matching PO record for 2219? I can try a fuzzy match by PR id.
sarah: Yes PR 2219 exists. PO 2219 was issued but vendor sometimes omits PO on their PDFs.
ap-bot: System: Invoice 49201 created (status NEEDS_PO) by AP ingestion 2026-03-24T09:12:03Z. Attached PDF checksum abc123.
tom: If vendor omitted PO we can attach the PO in AP and reroute to approver. Does AP allow manual PO assignment?
rachel: Yes - AP admin can add "linked purchase order" from UI or via API. I can do it but need the approver email for the cost center.
sarah: Approver for ML-RESEARCH is eng-ml-approvers@redwood.com (primary: rachel). GL code `6105` per PR.
rachel: ok will attach PO 2219 and set GL 6105.
ap-bot: Audit: User rachel linked PO 2219 to invoice 49201 at 2026-03-24T09:18:40Z and set GL 6105. Status updated to PENDING_APPROVAL.
tom: Great. Could we also add a short vendor note and ask Aether to include PO by default? We keep seeing this.
sarah: Agreed. I'll open a support ticket with vendor ops and include a sample invoice with callouts.
rachel: Leaving a one-off exception so AP doesn't hold this for payment run. Marking invoice as high-priority for this pay cycle.
ap-bot: Payment run flag: PRIORITY_SET by rachel at 2026-03-24T09:19:20Z.
sarah: Ticket created: #SUP-4821 to Aether Ops asking for PO on future invoices.
tom: Thx all. Closing once payment completes.
sarah: Closing after payment. :white_check_mark:
